title: Rigid Order–Disorder Interfaces in Continuous-Spin Models
exact_target: Prove that the order--disorder interface stays rigid in the proposed continuous-spin model in dimension at least three.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000776 (OWR-1544-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Phase Transitions (2007), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2007/28, pp. 1575--1650; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 66.

status_qualification: The source writes S^1=R/Z but also writes cos(r), whose angular period is 2 pi. Those expressions require an explicit rescaling convention: a period-one representative uses cos(2 pi r), while a radian representative uses cos(r). The catalogue formula is retained; it cannot be used literally as a well-defined period-one potential without this convention. The report's toy and clock-model theorems do not settle the smooth continuous-spin model.
